prompt: From your git repository root, create a user-friendly changelog markdown file named CHANGELOG.md summarizing all commits made between March 1, 2024 and March 15, 2024. The changelog must include categorized sections for New Features, Improvements, Bug Fixes, and Breaking Changes. Exclude any commits related to tests, refactoring, or internal maintenance. Use clear, customer-facing language rather than technical jargon. Format the changelog as a Markdown file with headings and bullet points. Output the complete changelog to CHANGELOG.md with no extra files or console output.
